item.tib: stag la phur bu rtse med kyi rgyud las stag nga bu khrag 'thung
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni dbal bon gyis/ phung bon la rgyud (brgyud) cing / dar nub res shig byung kyang (yang) / ma 'ongs dus su kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis/ gyim shod ri bo'i nub phyogs mdun zhol du bgyis pas g.yung drung bon bstan dge legs 'phel rgyas shog
